<subject>coordination with Karratha Terminal</subject>
<body>
I spoke with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning regarding the MINEPLAN system and the Karratha Terminal process.

Bryan has prepared both inbound and outbound load lists which he will send over so that Portside Logistics can verify counterparty contract termination details. I believe Karratha Terminal can adopt our newly implemented procedures as a model. Bryan and others will join the 9:30 a.m. conference call on 5 February.

John and Randy: Could you please provide Bryan with a copy of the "Ironclad Bulk Shipping" template, or if replaced, the latest version? Also, the Bulk Freight Alliance template?

Kyle: Can you send Bryan and Meredith Green the decision tree and the settlement workflow diagram?

If tomorrow’s handouts are ready and include these items, they should cover all that Karratha Terminal requires.

Thanks. SS
